findings.issue: The PR combines several unrelated targets in one unit: (1) the Brauer quaternion-symbol product formula brauer2EquivH2_quaternionClass_mul (CupProduct.lean, Layer 7); (2) the full-polar/Gram matrix determinant (new Matrix.lean, Layer 3); (3) the trace-transfer discriminant discr_traceTransfer plus its ℚ/ℚ₂/ℂ worked examples (Discriminant.lean + new Transfer/Examples.lean, Layer 9); (4) the Hilbert-symbol uniformizer-unit expansion hilbertSymbol_zpow_mul_zpow_mul (Bimultiplicativity.lean, Layer 6); (5) the local invariant of the Hasse class (new Invariant.lean, Layer 6C); (6) the binary worked examples ⟨1,1⟩≅⟨2,2⟩ and ⟨1,1⟩-vs-hyperbolic (Binary.lean, Witt/Decomposition.lean). None depends on another within the PR.

summary: The individual additions each have a roadmap home under QuadraticFormInvariants, but the PR is not a single topic: it bundles six mutually independent results across three top-level directories (CrossedProduct, LinearAlgebra/QuadraticForm, NumberTheory/LocalField) and roadmap Layers 3, 6, 6C, 7 and 9. Split it.
